Computational Materials Scientist – Theoretical Physicist

Henry is a computational materials scientist and theoretical physicist currently working as a Severo Ochoa postdoctoral researcher at the Basque Center for Applied Mathematics (BCAM) in Spain. He has been awarded a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowship (MSCA-PF-2025) for the project MULTI-SMARTSEI, focused on multiscale modeling of solid-state electrolyte interphases in next-generation lithium batteries. His research centers on atomistic and multiscale modeling of materials for energy storage, with particular emphasis on solid-state and lithium-based batteries. He combines first-principles calculations, molecular dynamics, and data-driven analysis to study ion transport, interfacial phenomena, and structure–property relationships in complex materials systems.
